mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces the cost of capital and stimulates economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions and reduced consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and residential sales (RSAFS) indicate a dual supply-demand shock, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as economic activity contracts.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% in the past month
failure_condition: When INDPRO and RSAFS both decline by more than 0.5% in a month, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 4.5% for at least 3 months), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs.
failure_condition: In periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising for 3 months, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity and strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: When INDPRO rises, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% signals persistent inflation, prompting aggressive monetary tightening that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%, SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 600,000 units signals weak consumer demand and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, as housing is a leading indicator of economic activity.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 600.0, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts (HOUST) and residential sales (RSAFS) indicate a contraction in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% in the past month
failure_condition: When HOUST and RSAFS both decline by more than 0.5% in a month, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
